description: Structured knowledge base for the Cortex AI assistant. Contains FAQs, feature explanations, how-to guides, troubleshooting, and terminology.

faqs.question: How do I create a lead?
faqs.answer: Go to Opportunities in the sidebar. Click '+ New Opportunity'. Fill in: name, stage (set to 'New Lead' or 'Contacted'), value, expected close date, and link to an Account. Click Save. You can also ask me: 'Create a lead for [marina name]' and I will do it for you.

faqs.question: How do I convert a lead to an opportunity?
faqs.answer: In VoltSafe Cortex, leads and opportunities are the same record type — they progress through stages. To 'convert' a lead, simply update its stage from 'New Lead' or 'Contacted' to 'Qualified'. This signals it has passed the initial qualification step. You can do this by opening the opportunity, clicking the Stage dropdown, and selecting 'Qualified'.

faqs.question: Why is an opportunity showing as stale?
faqs.answer: An opportunity is marked stale when there has been no logged activity for a defined number of days (typically 7–14 days). To fix it: open the opportunity, log an activity (call, email, or note) in the Timeline section, and update the stage if it has moved. The stale flag will clear once activity is logged.

faqs.question: How do I send a quote?
faqs.answer: Go to Quotes in the sidebar. Click '+ New Quote'. Select the Account. Add line items by clicking '+ Add Line Item' and choosing products. Review totals. Click 'Send' to deliver to the customer or 'Save as Draft' to finish later. The quote status will update to 'Sent' automatically.

faqs.question: What does weighted pipeline mean?
faqs.answer: Weighted pipeline is the sum of all your open deal values multiplied by their probability of closing. For example, a $100,000 deal at 50% probability contributes $50,000 to the weighted pipeline. It gives a more realistic revenue estimate than the raw pipeline total. A healthy pipeline has weighted value of at least 1x your revenue target.

faqs.question: How do I assign tasks in bulk?
faqs.answer: Go to Tasks Hub. Check the boxes on the left side of the tasks you want to reassign. A bulk action toolbar will appear at the top of the page. Click 'Reassign' and select the new owner. Click Confirm. You can also bulk-complete, bulk-delete, or bulk-update priority from the same toolbar.

faqs.question: Where do I find install workflows?
faqs.answer: Go to the sidebar and look under the Revenue Engine section. Click 'Install Workflows'. You will see all active and completed installation workflows. Each workflow shows the marina name, current phase, and completion status. Click any workflow to see the detailed step-by-step checklist.

faqs.question: How do I log a phone call?
faqs.answer: Open the Account, Contact, or Opportunity the call was about. Scroll to the Timeline section. Click '+ Log Activity'. Select type 'Call'. Write a brief summary of what was discussed and any outcomes. Set the date. Click Save. The call will appear in the timeline immediately.

faqs.question: How do I connect my Gmail?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings → My Mailboxes (in the sidebar under Admin). Click 'Connect Gmail'. Sign in with your Google account and approve the permissions. Your inbox will sync within a few minutes. Once connected, all emails to/from CRM contacts will automatically link to their records.

faqs.question: What is a warmness score?
faqs.answer: Warmness score is a 0–100 rating that measures how actively you are emailing with an account. It is calculated based on how recently you emailed them and how often. Score 70–100: warm relationship. Score 40–69: cooling off. Score 0–39: cold — needs re-engagement. You can see it on any Account profile.

faqs.question: How do I find duplicate accounts?
faqs.answer: Go to Data Quality Center in the sidebar (under Revenue Engine). The page will flag potential duplicates. Click on any flagged duplicate pair to review them. If they are duplicates, click 'Merge' and choose which record to keep as the primary. All data from the secondary record will be merged into the primary.

faqs.question: How do I create an automation?
faqs.answer: Go to Automations in the sidebar (under Operations). Click '+ New Rule'. Choose a trigger (e.g., 'Deal stage changes'). Set your conditions. Choose the action (e.g., 'Create task' or 'Send alert'). Give it a name. Save and toggle it to Active. The rule will run automatically from that point on.

faqs.question: How do I update a deal stage?
faqs.answer: Open the opportunity. Click the 'Stage' dropdown at the top of the record. Select the new stage. The change saves automatically. You can also drag the deal card to a new column in Pipeline board view.

faqs.question: How do I export contacts to CSV?
faqs.answer: Go to Contacts. Apply any filters you want (optional). Click the Export button (usually a download icon or in the '...' menu). Select 'Export to CSV'. The file will download to your computer. Note: export requires appropriate permissions.

faqs.question: What is the Today page?
faqs.answer: The Today page (/today) is your personal daily dashboard. It shows meetings scheduled for today, tasks due today or overdue, hot opportunities needing attention, and AI-generated next best actions. Open it every morning as your starting point.

faqs.question: How do I create a saved view?
faqs.answer: Go to Opportunities, Accounts, or Contacts. Set your filters to exactly what you want to save. Look for the 'Save View' button or bookmark icon near the filter bar. Click it and give your view a name. It will now appear in the view selector dropdown so you can access it instantly.

faqs.question: How do I see all tasks assigned to my team?
faqs.answer: Go to Tasks Hub. In the filter options at the top, switch from 'My Tasks' to 'All Tasks'. You can then filter by assignee to see a specific person's tasks, or see everything across the team. Managers can also use Team Workload (/execution/team-workload) for a visual overview.

faqs.question: How do I generate a board pack?
faqs.answer: Go to Board Pack in the sidebar. Select the time period you want the report to cover. Click 'Generate'. The system will compile revenue performance, pipeline health, key deals, and forecast data into a formatted report. You can view it in-app or download it as a PDF.

faqs.question: How do I add a note to an account?
faqs.answer: Open the Account. Scroll to the Timeline section. Click '+ Add Note'. Type your note. Click Save. The note will appear in the timeline with a timestamp and your name.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: On the login page, click 'Forgot your password?' and follow the instructions. Alternatively, ask your Admin — they can reset your password from Admin → Users → find your account → Reset Password.

faqs.question: How do I change user permissions?
faqs.answer: Admin access is required. Go to Admin → Users. Find the user. Click on their name. In their profile, look for the Permissions section. You can set each module to 'None', 'View', or 'Edit'. Save when done. Changes take effect on the user's next page load.

faqs.question: What is the command bar?
faqs.answer: The command bar is a quick-access search and navigation tool. Open it by pressing ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows). Type anything — an account name, contact, page name, or action — and the system will show matching results. It is the fastest way to navigate Cortex.

faqs.question: How do I link an email to an account?
faqs.answer: Emails sent and received through the Cortex Gmail inbox are automatically linked to accounts based on email domain matching. If an email is not auto-linked, open the email in the Gmail inbox, look for the 'Link to Account' option in the right panel, search for the account, and manually link it.

faqs.question: What is pipeline coverage ratio?
faqs.answer: Pipeline coverage ratio is total pipeline value divided by your revenue target. Example: $600,000 in pipeline with a $200,000 target = 3x coverage. A ratio of 3x or higher is considered healthy because not all deals will close. Below 2x is a warning sign that more deals need to be created.

faqs.question: How do I mark an opportunity as won or lost?
faqs.answer: Open the opportunity. Click the Stage dropdown. Select 'Closed Won' or 'Closed Lost'. For Closed Lost, you may be prompted to enter a loss reason — always fill this in, as it helps improve future performance. Save the record.

faqs.question: How do I search for an account?
faqs.answer: Three ways: 1) Go to Accounts page and use the search bar at the top. 2) Press ⌘K anywhere and type the name. 3) Use Global Search at /search. All three will find the account within seconds.

faqs.question: How do I assign a task to someone?
faqs.answer: When creating or editing a task, look for the 'Assigned To' or 'Owner' field. Type the person's name and select them from the dropdown. Save the task. They will see it in their Tasks Hub under 'My Tasks'.

faqs.question: What is the Executive Copilot?
faqs.answer: The Executive Copilot (/executive-copilot) is an AI-powered daily briefing system. Every morning it analyzes your CRM data and generates: a summary of the business state, alerts about at-risk deals, suggested priority actions, and revenue tracking vs. targets. It is designed for leadership to start the day with full situational awareness.

faqs.question: How do I add a contact to an account?
faqs.answer: Option 1: Go to the Account profile. Look for a 'Contacts' tab. Click '+ Add Contact'. Fill in their details. Option 2: Create the contact from Contacts page and in the Account field, type and select the company. Both methods link the contact to the account.

faqs.question: How do I set up an email campaign?
faqs.answer: Go to Communications (/execution/communications). First, create or select a contact list under 'Lists'. Then click '+ New Campaign', choose the list as your audience, write your email content, set the send time, and launch. Track open rates and replies from the campaign dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I use the Revenue Simulator?
faqs.answer: Go to Revenue Simulator (/revenue-sim). You can adjust deal counts, average deal sizes, and close rates using the input sliders. The simulator recalculates projected revenue in real time. Use it for scenario planning: 'What if we add 5 more deals this quarter?' Save scenarios to compare them.

faqs.question: What are email signals?
faqs.answer: Email signals are automatic alerts generated from email activity patterns. Examples: no reply received in 14 days, an email opened multiple times (signals high interest), or a bounce detected. Signals appear on account profiles and in the Signals feed (/intelligence/signals). Act on them promptly.

faqs.question: How do I delete a record?
faqs.answer: Open the record (account, contact, opportunity, etc.). Look for a 'Delete' option in the '...' menu or action dropdown. Confirm the deletion. Note: deletion is permanent. If you only want to hide a deal, consider setting it to 'Closed Lost' instead of deleting it.

faqs.question: How do I track a renewal?
faqs.answer: Go to Renewals (/renewals) in the sidebar. This page shows all accounts with upcoming contract renewals. You can see the renewal date, contract value, and current status. Click any account to start the renewal conversation. Consider setting up an automation to create a follow-up task 90 days before renewal.

faqs.question: What does 'Close Date' mean?
faqs.answer: Close date is the date you expect to either win or lose a deal. It should be realistic — not optimistic. An overdue close date (in the past) is a red flag that the deal has been neglected. Update close dates as soon as you know the timeline has shifted.

faqs.question: How do I see my team's workload?
faqs.answer: Go to Team Workload (/execution/team-workload). This page shows each team member's current task load — how many tasks they have, which are overdue, and capacity indicators. Use it to redistribute work and prevent bottlenecks.

faqs.question: How do I view a contact's email history?
faqs.answer: Open the Contact's profile. Click the Timeline tab. All emails sent to and from that contact will appear here chronologically. You can also see notes, calls, and meetings in the same view.

faqs.question: What is source attribution?
faqs.answer: Source attribution (/analytics/source-attribution) tracks where your leads and deals originally came from — whether that is inbound website traffic, referrals, outbound cold calls, partnerships, or events. Use it to identify which channels are producing the highest-value deals and focus your efforts accordingly.

faqs.question: How do I create a user account for a new employee?
faqs.answer: Admin access required. Go to Admin → Users. Click '+ New User'. Enter their name, email, and temporary password. Assign their role (admin, sales, operations, etc.) and set module-level permissions. Click Save. They can log in immediately and will be prompted to change their password.

faqs.question: How do I use the Jira integration?
faqs.answer: Go to Jira in the sidebar. You can view Jira issues linked to CRM accounts, create new issues from within Cortex, and track project progress. To link a Jira issue to an account, open the account and use the Jira panel to search for or create the issue. Requires Jira to be connected in Admin → Integrations.

faqs.question: How do I view the geography of my leads?
faqs.answer: Go to Geography (/geography) in the sidebar. This page shows a map view of your accounts and leads by location. Use it to identify geographic clusters, plan field visits efficiently, and understand regional coverage gaps.

faqs.question: How do I use bulk actions on accounts?
faqs.answer: Go to Accounts. Check the boxes on the left of the rows you want. A bulk action bar appears. Options include: Export to CSV, Bulk Assign Owner, Bulk Add Tag, Bulk Delete. Always double-check your selection before confirming bulk delete — it cannot be undone.

faqs.question: What is the Activity Feed?
faqs.answer: The Activity Feed (/activity) shows a real-time stream of all CRM changes across the system — new accounts created, deals moved, tasks completed, emails sent, and more. Use it to stay aware of what the team is doing and catch anything that needs attention.

faqs.question: Can Cortex AI write to the CRM for me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cortex can perform write operations on your behalf. You can say things like: 'Update Marina Bay's deal stage to Negotiation', 'Create a task to follow up with Harbor Point next Tuesday', or 'Add a note to the Pacific Marina account'. Cortex will find the record, confirm what it is about to do, and apply the change.

faqs.question: How does Cortex AI search the web?
faqs.answer: When you ask Cortex a question that requires external information (e.g., 'What is the latest news about marina electrification?'), it automatically searches the web and summarizes the results. You do not need to do anything special — just ask the question naturally.

faqs.question: How do I set up an install workflow?
faqs.answer: Go to Install Workflows in the sidebar. Click '+ New Workflow'. Name it (usually the marina name + project type). Add each step in the install process. For each step, set a description, assigned owner, and expected completion date. Save. The field team updates each step as they complete it.

faqs.question: How do I filter the pipeline by date range?
faqs.answer: Go to Pipeline. Look for the filter bar at the top. Click 'Filters' and add a filter for 'Close Date'. You can set a specific date range (e.g., this quarter). The pipeline will update to show only deals expected to close in that range.

faqs.question: What is deal velocity?
faqs.answer: Deal velocity measures how fast your deals move through the pipeline, typically expressed as days to close from creation. Faster velocity means a more efficient sales process. You can see deal velocity metrics on the Executive Dashboard and Revenue Hub pages.

faqs.question: How do I upload a document to an account?
faqs.answer: Open the Account profile. Look for a Documents tab or the Documents section in the sidebar. Click 'Upload'. Select your file. Add a title and optional tags. The document will be linked to the account and visible to anyone with access.

faqs.question: How do I fix an account with missing information?
faqs.answer: Go to Data Quality Center first to see what fields are flagged as missing. Or open the account directly, click Edit, and fill in the empty fields (address, phone, website, etc.). Save when done. Completing key fields improves warmness scoring, signals accuracy, and reporting.

faqs.question: What does pipeline coverage ratio mean?
faqs.answer: Pipeline coverage ratio = total pipeline value ÷ revenue target. A 3x ratio means you have $3 in pipeline for every $1 of target. This buffer is needed because not all deals will close. Below 2x is a warning sign. Above 4x may mean your pipeline has too many unlikely deals.

faqs.question: How do I track procurement status?
faqs.answer: Go to Procurement (/procurement) in the sidebar. Each purchase order shows the supplier, items ordered, quantity, status (ordered, in transit, received), and linked project. Update the status as equipment moves through the supply chain.

faqs.question: What is territory routing?
faqs.answer: Territory routing (/routing) helps plan efficient visit routes for field sales reps. It shows nearby accounts on a map and can suggest optimized visit sequences. Use it before a field trip to minimize drive time between marina visits.

faqs.question: How do I add a price list?
faqs.answer: Go to Price Lists (/price-lists) in the sidebar. Click '+ New Price List'. Add your products with names, descriptions, and prices. Assign it to a category. Once created, products from the price list will be available when building quotes.

faqs.question: How do I escalate a support ticket?
faqs.answer: Open the ticket. Change the Severity to 'Critical' or 'High'. Reassign it to a senior team member. Add a note explaining the escalation reason. You can also use the @mention feature in comments to alert a specific person.

faqs.question: What is the Relationship Intelligence page?
faqs.answer: Relationship Intelligence (/relationships or /intelligence/rel-intelligence) shows a visual analysis of your relationship network. It highlights which accounts have strong vs. weak relationships, who your key connectors are, and relationship trends over time.

faqs.question: How do I view Confluence pages from inside Cortex?
faqs.answer: Go to Confluence in the sidebar. If it is connected, you will see your Confluence spaces. Browse or search for pages. You can read pages directly without leaving Cortex. To connect Confluence, go to Admin → Integrations.

faqs.question: How do I see which deals closed this month?
faqs.answer: Go to Opportunities. Filter by Stage = 'Closed Won' and Close Date = this month. You can also ask Cortex: 'Show me all deals won this month' for an instant list.

faqs.question: How do I send an email from inside a deal?
faqs.answer: Open the Opportunity. In the Timeline or Actions section, click 'Send Email' or 'Compose'. The email form will pre-fill the contact's email address. Write your message. Send. The email is automatically logged in the timeline and linked to the deal and account.

faqs.question: What is the Winter Support module?
faqs.answer: Winter Support (/winter) is a specialized module for managing support cases and operational issues related to seasonal marina operations. It includes case tracking, escalation workflows, and priority flagging specific to winter operational challenges.

faqs.question: How do I see my win rate?
faqs.answer: Go to Executive Dashboard (/executive-dashboard) for a high-level win rate metric. For a detailed breakdown, go to Source Attribution or ask Cortex: 'What is my win rate this quarter?' Cortex can calculate it from your closed won vs. closed lost opportunities.

faqs.question: How do I set a task due date?
faqs.answer: When creating or editing a task, look for the 'Due Date' field. Click on it to open a date picker. Select the date. For recurring tasks, you can set a repeat frequency. Tasks past their due date will show as overdue and appear highlighted in the Tasks Hub.

faqs.question: How do I add a tag to a record?
faqs.answer: Open the account, contact, or opportunity. Look for the Tags field (usually in the Edit view). Type a tag name and press Enter. Tags help with filtering and searching. You can filter the Accounts or Opportunities list by tag to find specific groups.

faqs.question: What happens when I suspend a user?
faqs.answer: A suspended user cannot log in. Their data remains intact — activities, notes, and records they created stay in the system. Suspended users still appear as assigned owners on records. Use suspension when an employee leaves. Admin access is required.

faqs.question: How do I use the Jira integration to create an issue?
faqs.answer: Open an Account or Opportunity. In the Jira panel (if connected), click '+ Create Issue'. Fill in the issue title, type, and description. The issue will be created in Jira and linked to the CRM record. You can see it under the Jira tab on the account.

faqs.question: How do I check if my emails are being delivered?
faqs.answer: Go to Gmail (/gmail) in the sidebar. In the Sent folder, you can see delivery status. For campaign emails, go to Communications and open the campaign to see open rates, delivery rates, and bounce alerts.

faqs.question: Can I use voice to interact with Cortex?
faqs.answer: Yes. Click the microphone icon in the Cortex AI assistant panel. Speak your question or command. Cortex will transcribe it and respond with both text and voice. This works great hands-free — for example when reviewing accounts on a call or driving between site visits.

faqs.question: How do I see all activities logged by a specific rep?
faqs.answer: Go to Activity Feed (/activity). Use the filter to select the specific team member as the author. The feed will show all activities they have logged. You can also go to Reports or ask Cortex: 'Show me all activities logged by [rep name] this week'.

faqs.question: How do I handle a lost deal?
faqs.answer: Open the opportunity. Change the stage to 'Closed Lost'. Fill in the loss reason when prompted (competitor won, budget, timing, etc.). Add a note with any useful context. This data improves future pipeline analysis and helps identify patterns in lost deals.

faqs.question: How do I know if my pipeline is healthy?
faqs.answer: A healthy pipeline has: 1) Coverage ratio of 3x or higher. 2) No more than 20% of deals in stale status. 3) Deals spread across multiple stages — not all bunched at 'New Lead'. 4) Close dates that are realistic and current. Ask Cortex: 'Evaluate my pipeline health' for an AI assessment.

faqs.question: How do I run a report on revenue by region?
faqs.answer: Go to Executive Dashboard or Revenue Hub and look for regional breakdown charts. For detailed data, go to Geography (/geography) which shows revenue and deal distribution by location. You can also ask Cortex: 'Show me revenue by region this quarter'.

faqs.question: What is the Daily Execution page?
faqs.answer: Daily Execution (/execution/daily) is a focused task view for working through high-priority items. It is designed for reps who want a distraction-free view of just what needs to be done today, without the full Tasks Hub interface.

faqs.question: How do I archive an old account?
faqs.answer: You cannot archive accounts directly in the current version — you can mark them Inactive by editing the account status field. Setting an account to Inactive removes it from default list views but keeps all its history. Use this for marinas that are no longer customers.

faqs.question: How do I set up Cortex notifications?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings. Look for the Notifications section. You can enable or disable notifications for: new tasks assigned to you, deal stage changes, stale deal alerts, email signal triggers, and system alerts. Set your preferences and save.

faqs.question: How do I add someone to a project?
faqs.answer: Go to Projects (/execution/projects). Open the project. Look for the Team Members or Assigned Users section. Click '+ Add Member'. Search for the team member's name and select them. They will now have visibility into the project and can be assigned tasks within it.

faqs.question: Can I use Cortex on mobile?
faqs.answer: VoltSafe Cortex is a web application that works in mobile browsers. The interface is responsive and usable on phones and tablets. For field use, the voice feature of Cortex AI is especially useful — you can ask questions hands-free while on-site at a marina.

faqs.question: How does the engagement scheduler work?
faqs.answer: The engagement scheduler runs automatically in the background every 6 hours. It evaluates all accounts and contacts against engagement rules you have set up in Automations. When a rule triggers (e.g., no email in 14 days), it creates an alert or task automatically.

faqs.question: How do I view an account's full email history?
faqs.answer: Open the Account profile. Click the Timeline tab. Emails are listed chronologically alongside calls, meetings, and notes. You can filter the timeline to show only emails by using the activity type filter. This shows all inbound and outbound emails associated with that account.

faqs.question: What is the Score or Hot Score on leads?
faqs.answer: VoltSafe Cortex has an AI scoring engine that rates opportunities on multiple dimensions: lead quality, close probability, churn risk, expansion likelihood, and more. Scores update automatically based on CRM data. Higher scores = higher priority. Use the hot list view to see your top-scored opportunities.

faqs.question: How do I export a quote as PDF?
faqs.answer: Open the quote. Look for the 'Download PDF' or 'Export PDF' button. The quote will be formatted and downloaded as a professionally styled PDF document, ready to send to the customer.

faqs.question: How do I view deals by account manager?
faqs.answer: Go to Opportunities. Click 'Filters'. Add a filter for 'Owner' and select the account manager's name. The list will show only their deals. You can combine with Stage or Date filters for more specific views. Save as a Saved View if you need this regularly.

faqs.question: What is a rollout phase in deployments?
faqs.answer: A rollout phase is a stage in the physical deployment of VoltSafe hardware. Phases might include: Site Assessment, Equipment Delivery, Installation, Testing, Go Live. Each phase has a status, responsible person, and expected date. Track them in Deployments (/deployments).

faqs.question: How do I use the global calendar?
faqs.answer: Go to Calendar (/execution/calendar). The calendar shows team events, scheduled site visits, proposal deadlines, and task due dates. You can create events directly in Cortex or connect your external calendar via CalDAV sync in Settings.

faqs.question: How do I merge two contacts?
faqs.answer: Currently, merging contacts is done through the Data Quality Center. Go to Data Quality, find the duplicate flagged contacts, and use the Merge function. Choose which contact record to keep as the primary and which to merge in. All activities and linked records will be combined.

faqs.question: How do I view my notification history?
faqs.answer: Click the bell icon in the top navigation bar. This opens your notification panel showing recent alerts, mentions, and system events. Unread notifications appear highlighted. Click any notification to go directly to the relevant record.

faqs.question: What is the Notes page?
faqs.answer: Notes (/notes) is a centralized view of all notes logged across the entire CRM. It is useful for finding notes written about specific topics across multiple accounts, or for reviewing what your team has been documenting recently.

faqs.question: How do I track my email reply rate?
faqs.answer: Email reply metrics are available in the Gmail inbox view within Cortex and in the Email Engagement reports. For individual account tracking, look at the email signal for 'no reply received'. For campaign tracking, go to Communications and open the campaign report.

faqs.question: How do I see what changed on an account?
faqs.answer: Open the Account. The Timeline tab shows every change: when fields were updated, by whom, and to what value. Activities, emails, and status changes all appear here. For a system-wide view, check the Activity Feed (/activity).

faqs.question: How do I create a partnership record?
faqs.answer: Go to Partnerships in the sidebar (under Growth Channels). Choose the partnership type (Industry, OEM, Government, etc.). Click '+ New Partnership'. Fill in the organization name, contact person, status, and any notes. Save. Partnership records track the relationship status and history with external strategic partners.

faqs.question: How do I see deals that are at risk?
faqs.answer: Risk indicators appear on the Command Center and Executive Dashboard pages. You can also filter Opportunities by high risk score. Or ask Cortex: 'Show me deals at risk of being lost'. Cortex uses scoring signals to identify at-risk deals based on deal age, lack of activity, and competitive signals.

faqs.question: Can Cortex schedule a meeting for me?
faqs.answer: Cortex can help you identify who to meet and create a task to schedule a meeting. Direct calendar booking through Cortex is not currently automated — use the Calendar page to create the event manually, or sync with your external calendar via CalDAV in Settings.

faqs.question: How do I view a report by month?
faqs.answer: On the Executive Dashboard, Revenue Hub, or Source Attribution pages, use the date range picker in the top right to select a specific month or custom date range. The metrics will update to reflect that period.

faqs.question: What is 'expansion likelihood' on an account?
faqs.answer: Expansion likelihood is an AI-generated score that predicts how likely an existing customer is to expand their contract — buying more products, adding slips, or upgrading their plan. High expansion likelihood accounts are upsell targets. The score is visible on account profiles and in the scoring views.

faqs.question: How do I link a project to an account?
faqs.answer: When creating or editing a project, look for the 'Account' field. Type the account name and select it from the dropdown. Once linked, the project will appear in the account's profile and timeline, giving a full view of the customer relationship.

faqs.question: How do I add a comment to a support ticket?
faqs.answer: Open the ticket from Support → Tickets. Scroll to the comments section at the bottom. Type your comment in the text box. Click 'Add Comment'. Comments are visible to anyone with access to the ticket and appear in chronological order.

faqs.question: What is the Ecosystem section?
faqs.answer: The Ecosystem section contains tools for tracking broader industry relationships beyond direct sales: Ecosystem Organizations (industry bodies, associations), Ecosystem People (industry contacts not in active sales), and Ecosystem Events (conferences, trade shows). Use it to track your industry network.

faqs.question: How do I check if data quality has improved?
faqs.answer: Go to Data Quality Center (/data-quality). The page shows a score or count of issues. Run it monthly and compare the issue count over time. Fewer flagged issues = improving data quality. You can also ask Cortex: 'What is the current data quality score?'

faqs.question: How do I use the board pack for a meeting?
faqs.answer: Generate the board pack before the meeting (at least one day prior). Review it yourself first to understand the numbers. Download the PDF. Share it with attendees. During the meeting, use it as your reference for revenue performance, pipeline, and risk discussion. It auto-generates all the data you need.

faqs.question: How do I use automations to prevent stale deals?
faqs.answer: Create an automation rule: Trigger = 'Last activity date'. Condition = 'More than 7 days ago'. Action = 'Create task: Follow up on [deal name]' assigned to the deal owner. This ensures no deal can go stale without an automatic reminder being created.

faqs.question: What should I do if I suspect data is wrong?
faqs.answer: 1) Go to Data Quality Center to see flagged issues. 2) Open the specific record and compare it to what you know. 3) Click Edit and correct the data. 4) Add a note explaining the correction. 5) If the error is widespread, flag it to your Admin. Do not delete and recreate records — always edit to preserve the history.

troubleshooting.cause: User's permissions do not include that module
troubleshooting.fix: Ask Admin to grant access under Admin → Users → Permissions

troubleshooting.cause: Gmail not connected or OAuth token expired
troubleshooting.fix: Go to Settings → My Mailboxes → reconnect Gmail account

troubleshooting.cause: Possible spelling variation or record is in a filtered-out state
troubleshooting.fix: Use Global Search (⌘K) and search by email, phone, or partial name

troubleshooting.cause: Browser cache or save not triggering
troubleshooting.fix: Refresh the page. Re-open the deal and re-save the stage change
Be more specific. Include account names, dates, or stage names in your question

troubleshooting.cause: Same company created twice with different spelling
troubleshooting.fix: Go to Data Quality Center → find duplicates → use Merge function

troubleshooting.problem: Email sent outside Cortex not showing in timeline
troubleshooting.cause: Emails sent from external Gmail cannot be auto-imported
troubleshooting.fix: Manually log the email as an Email activity on the account timeline

troubleshooting.problem: Task showing in list after marking complete
troubleshooting.cause: Active filter may be set to 'All tasks' including completed
troubleshooting.fix: Switch filter to 'Open only' or 'My Tasks'

troubleshooting.cause: User has View-only permission for that module
troubleshooting.fix: Ask Admin to upgrade permission from View to Edit

troubleshooting.cause: Close dates not updated, or deals with wrong stages
troubleshooting.fix: Review all deals — update stages and close dates to reflect reality
